# Vendored from Taste Skill v2

Upstream: [Leonxlnx/taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill)  
Homepage: [tasteskill.dev](https://tasteskill.dev)  
Commit: `12af471f627f866411b4bd785b19646d3672784c`  
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Leonxlnx. The license text is in `LICENSE` beside this file.

Files copied unchanged from `skills/taste-skill/library/`:

- `library/directions.json` — the twenty art directions
- `library/heroes.json` — hero blueprints, including which direction each one belongs to
- `library/type.json` — type systems
- `library/palettes.json` — colour palettes

The deck ports the seeded deal in `skills/taste-skill/scripts/draw.mjs` (`directionPool`, `dealOptions`, `dealHero`, `dealType`, `dealPalette`, mulberry32). It does not vendor the script, the photograph library, or the archive search. Picture regions in the preview are flat palette fields.
